name: ISS cabin
description: Sea-level air in microgravity with forced ventilation.
assumptions: Ventilation flow range 5-20 cm/s is a placeholder: role E confirms it against a NASA source.

name: Lunar habitat
description: Oxygen-enriched, reduced-pressure exploration atmosphere at lunar gravity.
assumptions: The challenge page gives bounds (at least 30% O2, at most 10.2 psi). 34% O2 at 8.2 psi (56.5 kPa) is a point inside those bounds: role E confirms it against a NASA exploration-atmosphere reference.
Ventilation flow range is a placeholder.

name: Mars habitat
description: Same exploration atmosphere at Mars gravity.
assumptions: Assumes the same atmosphere as the lunar habitat preset.
Ventilation flow range is a placeholder.

name: Pressurized rover
description: Small crewed cabin with the exploration atmosphere at lunar gravity.
assumptions: Assumes the same atmosphere as the lunar habitat preset.
Ventilation flow range is a placeholder.

name: EVA spacesuit
assumptions: Gravity set to lunar surface; use 0 for an orbital spacewalk.
